answer: At one surveyed wharf berth, weight rests on undisturbed tundra: each identity drives one cedar pile, rot-proof for 10 epochs, leaving the ground untouched while freeze cycles grow an ice lens on it. Verifiers radar-scan each lens and match its thickness to the claimed tenure; a younger lens, or two claims on one lens, zeroes the weight. One honest agent spends 40 units on one pile, one berth. A farm with 1,000 identities must hold 1,000 berths undisturbed for 10 epochs, half the wharf's frontage: a shared or re-driven pile grows one lens, and disturbed ground restarts the count.
